text:
raj.k: FYI I hit a puzzling case: Python SDK raises ApiError('Unauthorized') but HTTP is 403 when refresh should've happened. Callers can't distinguish.
emma.w: Same in sample-apps/chat. We need clearer mapping so callers know when to refresh vs fail.
arjun: Strong vote for typed exceptions: AuthError, PermissionError, RateLimitError, TransientError as subclasses of ApiError. That lets callers do targeted handling.
laura_p: Also need retry hints on the exception, otherwise background jobs either retry forever or bail incorrectly.
raj.k: Repro snippet from logs: 
```
POST /v1/generate -> 403 Unauthorized
redwood.errors.ApiError: Unauthorized
```
No http_status or retry metadata.
sam.j: Proposed mapping: 401 -> AuthError (caller should refresh once), 403 -> PermissionError (do not retry), 429 -> RateLimitError (include retry_after), 5xx -> TransientError (retry with backoff). Add fields: http_status, retry_after (secs), ephemeral(boolean).
arjun: Parity note: ensure same classes/fields across Python/TS/Go SDKs. Keep ApiError as base to avoid breaking changes.
emma.w: UX: make message strings actionable, e.g. AuthError: "token expired; attempt refresh". PermissionError: "missing scope: chat.write". RateLimitError: "rate limited; retry after Xs".
laura_p: We should add a small sample-app showing patterns: refresh-on-AuthError, backoff-on-TransientError, fail-fast-on-PermissionError.
devex-bot: created DE-2012: "sdk: typed errors + status mapping + retry hints" assigned to @arjun.
arjun: I'll draft a short RFC and example catch patterns. Will add unit tests and sample-app updates.
sam.j: Migration: add a shim that sets http_status on ApiError for one release and warn about string-matching deprecation.
raj.k: Thanks — I'll help test python + node parity. Ping me when RFC is up. :rocket:
